title: Austin Talks Land, Appointments
summary:
*   City officials received a routine update on wastewater operations.
*   Discussions included potential appointments to various city boards and commissions.
*   A key topic was the possible reacquisition of urban renewal land previously sold for housing development.
*   No official decisions were made on any executive session items during this meeting.
